steps.tapRests: Tap the rhythm first: one tap for each note, and silence on the rests.
steps.wholeAndRests: A whole note lasts four beats: a whole bar in this music. A rest is a beat of silence: don’t play anything until the next note arrives.
steps.wholeNotes: Hold each whole note for four clicks.
steps.rests: The gaps between notes are rests. Stay silent during them.
